parameters.objective: Understand how confidence level determines margin of error and interval width, and evaluate the trade-off between certainty and precision

notes: Reviewed conceptual alignment: Evaluates the trade-off between confidence level and interval width with SE = 2.0 um. Critical values z = 1.645 (90%), 1.960 (95%), 2.576 (99%) produce widths 6.58, 7.84, and 10.30 um. Higher confidence requires wider intervals; increasing sample size n is the only way to narrow width while preserving confidence.
